scope: First pilot, explicit defaults; no crop or site calibration

sources.soil: SoilGrids250m2.0 mean, six intervals, real WCS regional rasters
sources.landcover: ESA WorldCover2021v200, native10m, dominant terrestrial class after10m UTM regridding
sources.meteorology: Already aligned ERA5 reanalysis at the existing representative point,24120 actual hourly records; not4096 independent meteorological measurements
sources.lai: NHI fact_svat.inp static annual curves as external analogues; compression and smoothing individually recorded

units.texture: SoilGrids g/kg -> percent, then renormalized to100%
units.bulk_density: cg/cm3 -> g/cm3 by/100; SWAP metadata kg/m3 byx1000

ptf.conductivity_fields: Use estimated Ksat in both native SWAP fields; retain predicted K0 and L as raw outputs only

priors.vegetation_parameter_authority: Heath RSC and LAI from documented NHI route. Other RSC, height and root values are explicit project defaults, not claimed to be locally measured or jointly calibrated.

boundary.exception: Six mapped herbaceous-wetland columns: SWBOTB5 and an assumed constant groundwater depth50cm below surface; unmeasured
boundary.managed_polders: Not positively identified from broad land-cover alone; grass/cropland review flags retained
boundary.future: European/regional groundwater-model heads and fluxes, including surface-water/drainage interaction

local_layers.application: Not silently assimilated in v01;159 majority-heath candidates are a separately prepared vegetation-only variant

geometry.source_effective_resolution: Target grid spacing does not create independent source information
